# Universal Ctags

Scope bundles Universal Ctags 6.2.1, obtained from the upstream release:
https://github.com/universal-ctags/ctags/releases/tag/v6.2.1

The complete upstream source is vendored in `source/`, including `COPYING`.
Universal Ctags is licensed under GPL version 2 or, at the user's option, any
later version. The bundled helper is built from that source with JSON support.

The helper uses the bundled Jansson 2.14 source in `ThirdParty/Jansson/source`.
Jansson is MIT licensed; its upstream license is retained in that source tree.
